response.text:
Two real problems, both fixable in the spec.

1. The opening hours note ("Ob nedeljah samo, če prej pokličete.") shows twice in the hours section, once as small text and once as bold text. The week variant seems to print the hours' own note and the section note. Removing the section note leaves one copy.
2. The contact call-out section repeats the address and directions that the hero label card already shows. The call-out also shows hours again, so the homepage has contact facts in several places. The hero is a trade template, so I keep it. The opening-hours section is the extra one, and hours are also in the call-out. Contact is the closing section of a trade template, so I keep it and drop only the duplicated note.

I leave the other items alone:
- The hero's overlapping header in the screenshot is a sticky header artefact of the full-page capture.
- The placeholders in the footer are intended.

The hero copy "Čebelarimo že 32 let" is in the client's text, so it stays.
